text_sanskrit: अभ्यासयोगयुक्तेन चेतसा नान्यगामिना । परमं पुरुषं दिव्यं याति पार्थानुचिन्तयन् ॥ ८-८ ॥
itrans: abhyAsayogayuktena chetasA nAnyagAminA . paramaM puruShaM divya.n yAti pArthAnuchintayan .. 8-8 ..
translation: With the mind furnished with the course of constant practice and not straying to any other thing, thinking upon the most exalted divine Person, he goeth to Him, O Partha.
